rows.concrete_observation: Registered Fox inherits Animal.attackEntityFrom: with enableOwnership and nonempty owner name, damage whose getEntity is EntityPlayer with different username returns false BEFORE parent damage and before health packet. The predicate does not test getIsTamed, UUID, alliance or world-wide player invulnerability. Same-name player, null/nonplayer source or disabled config falls through; source attribution engine internals not inspected. Animal and Aquatic implement the same gate and merge. Animal owner is watcher20, Aquatic21; NBT Owner persists and reloads. Native Fox rawTurkey interaction calls tameWithName: ownership-enabled capacity check may return false with chat; success stores username then opens name GUI on server and marks tamed. Base native freedom/sale/reset scroll branches clear owner with distinct permission/context, so ownership lifecycle can remove this protection. Fox hurt only retaliates if parent returned true; rejected foreign player therefore does not trigger that shown retaliation branch. Animal isNotScared branch restores old target and clears fleeing after parent, irrespective of parent result; Fox opts in. Allowed tamed hits send getHealth BEFORE parent settlement. sendHealth packet12 goes to all in dimension; receiver finds current loaded EntityLiving by integer ID then sets health, no UUID/generation reason. Animal onLivingUpdate additionally has 1/100 tamed health resync; do not claim pre-hit health persists forever. These packets are health snapshots, not immune feedback.
rows.application_to_boss_immune: Final refusal attribution must distinguish an explicit owner/source policy from generic hurt=false and transient health snapshots. Place truthful refused-hit receipts at the actual rejection, rather than deducing immunity from no health change or pre-hit sync. Preserve owner removal and source-qualified scope if borrowing the design; this is research only, no new pet/PVP feature requested.
rows.semantic_dedup: Single proposal for persisted nonempty-owner-name foreign-player rejection at final hurt. Animal/Aquatic adapters, watcher indices, Fox wrapper and shared health transport earn no separate credit. Master crocodile captive-only gate mentions parent ownership as uncounted context; this proposal expands that previously uncounted policy and full producer/lifecycle/consumer chain, not another captive damage case. Distinct from PNC024 owner-qualified re-taming admission: here final incoming damage is refused while owner may still hurt. Russell must decide relevance and semantic independence; helper credit0.
rows.limitations: Static historical MoCreatures API, not Minecraft1.20.1 port guidance. Config declaration/default is absent from selected cache and not claimed read; actual current config not proven. Does not prove all subclasses call parent before their own side effects, all indirect damage is player-attributed, engine health rendering, network correctness or actual immune sound/text. No per-target throttle, world-text/depth implementation or runtime test.

exclusions: Merge both base-class copies into one policy; existing crocodile/turtle/golem and Werewolf proposals not repeated.
Health sync and tame capacity chat provide context only, not new floating text/immune implementations. Config default and engine source attribution unproven.
counting_policy: Method/hash/file counts are not research credit. Fixed full containing methods plus manual observations; Russell must review semantic independence. Missing chains remain support0.
